prompt.description: A full caption of the result: describe the reference with the edit folded in (a one-line instruction such as "make it blue" reframes the shot). Refer to the n-th reference as <ref_image_n> in boxed edits.

images.description: Reference images in order (1-10): PNG, JPEG, HEIC or WebP. One reference is fitted to at most 4 megapixels and the result keeps its size; several are each scaled to about one megapixel and the result takes the first one's size.

width.description: Output width in pixels, a multiple of 16; omitted, the first reference's size.

height.description: Output height in pixels, a multiple of 16; omitted, the first reference's size.

steps.description: Denoising steps; the model is distilled for 16.
